modes.name_en: Invisible Hand: Emergent Order from Self-Interest
modes.definition_zh: 把'公共善如何产生'从'善良设计者的工程问题'改写为'分散自利如何被价格信号聚合的系统问题'：屠夫、酿酒师、面包师并非出于恩惠供给晚餐，而是出于自利；但正是这场逐利竞争，在没有人打算为公共利益服务的情况下，把资源持续推向公众最需要的地方。要害有三：其一，信息是分散且不可集中的——任何计划者的头脑都不可能装下一个社会的全部局部知识，价格以一个数字浓缩了供给、需求与稀缺的全部信息，让陌生人之间无需对话即可协作；其二，秩序可以是涌现的产物——市场秩序不是自上而下设计的成果，而是无数个体决策的副产物，判断制度好坏的标准因此不是设计者的意图而是涌现结果；其三，机制有效有前提——看不见的手只在产权明晰、竞争充分、无欺诈强制的制度框架内起作用，斯密同时是严厉的批评垄断与商人操纵立法者的人，'看不见的手'从不为纵容贪婪作辩护。方法论签名：不要问谁在为公共利益操盘——去检查那些让私人利益在追求自身时不得不服务他人的制度条件，条件成立时秩序自动涌现，条件缺失时再多善意的操盘手也堆不出一个市场。
modes.definition_en: The invisible hand rewrites the question of how public good arises: not as an engineering problem for a benevolent designer, but as a systems problem of how dispersed self-interest is aggregated into general welfare. Three disciplines give the mode its force. First, knowledge is dispersed and cannot be centralized: no planner's mind can hold a society's local knowledge of wants, resources, and opportunities; the price system condenses all of it into a single number, so strangers cooperate across continents without ever meeting or sharing a purpose—coordination replaces command. Second, order can be an emergent product: the market order is not the outcome of top-down design but a byproduct of countless individual decisions; the standard for judging an institution therefore shifts from the designer's intention to the emergent result, which explains why well-intentioned schemes fail and unintended arrangements succeed. Third, the mechanism is conditional, not magical: the invisible hand operates only inside a framework of secure property rights, genuine competition, and honest dealing; Smith himself was a fierce critic of monopoly, collusion, and merchants who capture legislation—'people of the same trade seldom meet together, even for merriment, but the conversation ends in a conspiracy against the public.' Self-interest left unchecked conspires against competition, producing rent-seeking rather than public good, and externalities are exactly where prices fall silent. The method is to audit the institutional conditions, not to worship the outcome. Signature: do not ask who is managing the public interest—examine the institutional conditions under which private advantage must serve others to serve itself; when the conditions hold, order emerges unbidden, and when they fail, no committee of benevolent managers can conjure a market into being.
modes.source_chapter: 《国富论》第四卷第二章 'Of Restraints upon the Importation from Foreign Countries'；《道德情操论》第四卷第一章（'看不见的手'首现）
process_zh: 识别分散信息：列出决策所需的局部知识（偏好、成本、稀缺），评估任何单一头脑能否集中掌握——通常不能
寻找聚合机制：确认该场景是否存在让分散自利相互碰撞的交换与竞争机制（价格、投标、匹配），没有就先搭建
审查制度前提：核对产权、竞争、诚实交易三项条件是否成立，排除垄断、欺诈与外部性对信号的扭曲
让结果涌现：停止逐项指挥，观察涌现结果是否改善公共福利，再据此微调规则而非直接干预价格
process_en: Map the dispersed information: list the local knowledge any decision requires (preferences, costs, scarcities) and test whether a single mind could hold it—it usually cannot
Find the aggregation mechanism: check whether an exchange-and-competition mechanism (prices, bids, matching) already lets self-interests collide; if absent, build it before intervening
Audit the institutional preconditions: verify property rights, competition, and honest dealing, and screen out the distortions of monopoly, fraud, and externalities
Let order emerge: stop directing item by item, observe whether the emergent outcome improves welfare, then tune the rules rather than overriding the price
representative_cases_zh: 1776年后英国取消谷物管制与重商主义特权：撤除特许公司与关税操纵后，粮食流通随价格自发跨区调配，饥荒性短缺被平抑——没有人指挥，供应自动流向缺粮地区
国际集装箱供应链：无人统一规划全球班轮时刻，但运价信号使数万艘船、港口与货主自发衔接，纽约的货架与深圳的工厂以陌生人协作连通
反例警示：2008年金融危机显示'看不见的手'的前提失灵——影子银行的自利在没有充分竞争与监管约束下聚合为系统性风险，抵押品链条以价格信号放大而非平抑泡沫；价格在信息被操纵时不是协调之手而是传染之线
反例警示：公地悲剧——无产权前提下的自利（公海过度捕捞）导致的不是公共善而是公共品的耗竭，证明机制只在产权明晰时涌现秩序

representative_cases_en.title: Grain trade deregulation
representative_cases_en.case: After Britain dismantled mercantilist privileges and restricted corporations, grain flowed across regions following price signals, and famine-grade shortages were smoothed over—no one directed the supply, yet it moved to where scarcity priced highest
representative_cases_en.counter_case: The 1972-73 world food crisis showed the reverse: when governments panicked into export bans, prices stopped aggregating information and shortages deepened—interference severed the aggregation mechanism

representative_cases_en.title: Global container shipping
representative_cases_en.case: No authority plans global liner schedules, yet freight-rate signals sync tens of thousands of ships, ports, and shippers, linking a New York shelf to a Shenzhen factory through pure stranger-cooperation
representative_cases_en.counter_case: COVID-era port congestion showed price signals jamming: freight rates spiked tenfold while queues lengthened, because physical bottlenecks meant higher prices bought no new capacity—signals coordinate only when supply can respond

representative_cases_en.title: The 2008 financial crisis
representative_cases_en.case: Securitized credit markets aggregated dispersed savings into mortgage lending at unprecedented scale—proof the aggregation machinery works at planetary scale
representative_cases_en.counter_case: The same crisis is the canonical counterexample: shadow-bank self-interest without competitive discipline and oversight aggregated into systemic risk, with collateral chains amplifying rather than damping the bubble—when information is manipulated, the invisible hand becomes a contagion wire

representative_cases_en.title: Tragedy of the commons
representative_cases_en.case: Where property rights are defined (ITQ fishing quotas), self-interest conserves the stock because scarcity is priced into each catch
representative_cases_en.counter_case: On the open seas, unowned self-interest produces depletion, not abundance—order emerges only when property rights give the price signal teeth

modern_applications_zh: 平台经济设计：电商与网约车以动态定价聚合分散供需，平台不指挥交易而只维护匹配规则与信誉体系
公共政策评估：任何产业补贴法案先问'它是否替代或扭曲了既有价格信号'，把干预的举证责任倒置
组织内部市场化：大企业用内部结算价与利润中心让部门自利聚合为公司利益，替代总部计划指令
机制设计审查：拍卖、限价、配额等政府机制上线前以'价格还能否携带真实信息'为压力测试
modern_applications_en: Platform economics: ride-hailing and e-commerce aggregate dispersed supply and demand through dynamic pricing—the platform directs no trades, it only maintains matching rules and reputation
Public-policy appraisal: any subsidy bill should first be asked whether it replaces or distorts an existing price signal, reversing the burden of proof for intervention
Internal markets in firms: internal transfer prices and profit centres let divisional self-interest aggregate into corporate interest, displacing headquarters' command plans
Mechanism-design stress testing: auctions, price caps, and quotas should be tested against one question before launch—can prices still carry truthful information?
modes.key_quote_zh: 我们的晚餐并非来自屠夫、酿酒师或面包师的恩惠，而是来自他们对自身利益的关切。
modes.key_quote_en: It is not from the benevolence of the butcher, the brewer, or the baker that we expect our dinner, but from their regard to their own interest.

modes.name_en: Division of Labour and the Productivity Leap
modes.definition_zh: 把'产出增长'从'加人加机器的线性问题'改写为'工序分解与专用化的跃迁问题'：斯密的制针厂把抽丝、拉直、切截、磨尖、装头等十八道工序分给十八个专门工人，日产量从人均一二十枚跃至四千八百枚，跃升来源被拆解为三项——技能熟练度的提升、工序切换时间的消除、以及机器发明（因工人专注于单一环节而更易被诱发）。要害有三：其一，分解先于增效——生产力跃迁的起点是把复合任务拆到'单一动作可被反复优化'的粒度，未经分解的岗位无论多努力都停在旧均衡；其二，分工受市场范围限制——只有当交换规模大到足以吸收专门化的全部产出时，分工才划算；萨伊与阿林·杨据此推出累积因果：分工扩大产出，产出扩大市场，更大的市场又催生更细分工，增长因此是内生自我加速的；其三，分工的代价是'心智的钝化'——斯密本人警告终日重复简单操作会使人'成为最愚钝无知的人'，这为教育与轮岗设计埋下伏笔。方法论签名：先分解任务，再谈努力——生产力的杠杆不在让人干得更多，而在把任务切到能让专业、机器与市场范围相互喂养的粒度。
modes.definition_en: The division of labour rewrites output growth: not a linear problem of adding labour and machines, but a leap achieved by decomposing the task and specializing each step. Three disciplines give the mode its force. First, decomposition precedes improvement: the starting point of any productivity leap is breaking a compound task down to the grain where a single motion can be repeatedly optimized; an undecomposed role, however hard-working, stays trapped at the old equilibrium. Second, the division of labour is limited by the extent of the market: specialization pays only when the scale of exchange is large enough to absorb the whole dedicated output; Say and Allyn Young turned this into cumulative causation—division of labour enlarges output, output enlarges the market, and the larger market induces still finer specialization, making growth endogenous and self-accelerating, with Young's famous 1928 paper declaring this 'the most illuminating' proposition in economics. Third, Smith himself named the cost: a man who performs a few simple operations his whole life 'becomes as stupid and ignorant as it is possible for a human creature to become'—the mind is dulled by routine, which is why mature division-of-labour design must budget for rotation, education, and re-skilling, never treating workers as permanent fixtures of a single operation. The method is to manage the coupling between task granularity, market size, and human capacity, never to maximize specialization in isolation. Signature: decompose the task before praising the effort—the lever of productivity lies not in making people work more, but in cutting tasks to the grain where specialization, machinery, and the extent of the market begin to feed one another.
modes.source_chapter: 《国富论》第一卷第一至三章 'Of the Division of Labour' 及 'That the Division of Labour is Limited by the Extent of the Market'；Allyn Young, 'Increasing Returns and Economic Progress' (1928)
process_zh: 任务分解：把复合流程拆为单一动作粒度的工序，逐项计时并标出切换损耗
评估市场承载力：估算交换规模能否吸收专门化后的全部产出，不达阈值则维持较低分工度或先扩市场
配置专用资产：按工序配置专用工具、设备与培训，诱发环节级机器与工艺创新
轮换与再训练：以轮岗与持续教育对冲专业化带来的心智钝化，保持工序弹性
process_en: Decompose the task: split the compound workflow into single-motion operations, time each, and flag all switching losses
Size the market: estimate whether exchange volume can absorb the full dedicated output; below threshold, keep integration or expand the market first
Deploy dedicated assets: match tools, equipment, and training to each operation, and invite operation-level machine and process innovation
Rotate and retrain: offset the mind-dulling cost of specialization with rotation and continuing education to keep the operation mix elastic
representative_cases_zh: 斯密的制针厂：十八道工序十八人，人均日产从不足二十枚跃至四千八百枚——增产近二百四十倍，全部来自分解与专用化而非加人或加班
福特T型车流水线：把制针逻辑推进到装配线，底盘装配时间从12.5小时降至93分钟，售价随之减半，市场扩大又反过来支撑更深分工——杨的累积因果闭环
反例警示：过度专门化的组织在环境突变时崩塌——柯达把分工优化到胶卷极致，却因工序与资产全部锚定在胶卷技术上而无法转向数码；专用化的收益与转换成本是同一枚硬币
反例警示：小市场中强行分工的浪费——偏远地区小厂照搬大厂超细分工，每道工序产能闲置，被协调成本吃光收益

representative_cases_en.title: Smith's pin factory
representative_cases_en.case: Eighteen operations, ten workers: per-capita daily output leaps from under twenty pins to forty-eight hundred—a near 240-fold gain from decomposition and specialization alone, not from more hours
representative_cases_en.counter_case: A craft workshop of the same era, refusing decomposition in the name of artisan pride, never escaped single-digit output—the task stayed at a grain no motion could ever be optimized on

representative_cases_en.title: Ford's moving assembly line
representative_cases_en.case: Chassis assembly fell from 12.5 hours to 93 minutes, the Model T's price halved, and the enlarged market funded still finer specialization—Young's cumulative causation in one loop
representative_cases_en.counter_case: GM's later shift to flexible multi-model platforms showed the boundary: when variety, not volume, becomes the binding demand, ultra-specialized single-model lines become a liability

representative_cases_en.title: Kodak's dead end
representative_cases_en.case: Kodak perfected the division of labour in film chemistry—decades of operation-level optimization gave it dominant quality and margin
representative_cases_en.counter_case: The same specialization killed it: skills and assets anchored to film could not pivot to digital, proving specialized gains and switching costs are the same coin

representative_cases_en.title: Over-specialization in small markets
representative_cases_en.case: A regional factory copying an automotive giant's fine-grained division of labour found every specialized station under-utilized
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Coordination overhead devoured the gains—the extent of the market, not ambition, sets the profitable division of labour

modern_applications_zh: 软件微服务拆分：把单体系统按业务边界分解为可独立部署的小服务，每个团队对单一服务反复优化
外科手术分科与SOP化：手术流程分解为麻醉、主刀、器械护士的专用角色，操作次数驱动的学习曲线使并发症率骤降
全球价值链分工：iPhone按比较优势拆到芯片、屏幕、组装各专精节点，市场全球化程度决定分工深度上限
岗位设计与再技能化：自动化企业以轮岗培训对冲'螺丝钉化'，按斯密的钝化警告保留人的可迁移性
modern_applications_en: Microservice decomposition: split a monolith along business boundaries into independently deployable services, letting each team iterate one operation to excellence
Surgical specialization: operating-room roles decomposed into anaesthetist, surgeon, and scrub nurse—the practice-driven learning curve collapses complication rates
Global value chains: a smartphone is decomposed across chips, displays, and assembly nodes by comparative advantage; the depth of the split is capped by how global the market is
Job design and re-skilling: automated firms budget rotation and training against Smith's mind-dulling warning, preserving workers' transferability
modes.key_quote_zh: 分工是受市场范围限制的——这是经济学中最富启发的命题之一。
modes.key_quote_en: The division of labour is limited by the extent of the market—one of the most illuminating generalisations in economics.

modes.name_en: Natural Price, Market Price and the Gravitation Mechanism
modes.definition_zh: 把'价格为何波动、又为何不散架'理解为三重结构：自然价格是恰好覆盖地租、工资与利润（按自然率）的'中心价格'，即商品'与其真实所值、真实成本相当'的锚；市场价格是实际成交价，受供给量与'有效需求'（愿付自然价格的需求）的对比而围绕中心波动；引力机制则是资本家追逐利润率的套利——市价高于自然价时超额利润吸引资本流入、供给增加、价格回落；低于时资本撤出、供给收缩、价格回升。要害有三：其一，区分锚与波动——把长期成本结构（自然价）与短期供需噪声（市价）分层，才能判断哪个价格信号可信、哪个是暂时偏离；其二，引力机制的主体是套利者——价格回归不是道德自律的结果，而是每个资本家'从不把资本用在不称心用途上'的持续逐利，市场出清的执行人正是逐利者本人；其三，引力会被阻尼——垄断、行业秘密、资本与劳动力的自由流动受阻都会放缓甚至冻结回归，斯密明言这些条件下市价可以长期背离自然价。方法论签名：任何一个价格都同时是三层信息的叠加——先问它偏离自然价有多远、套利通道是否畅通，再决定把它当作信号还是噪声，被垄断冻结的价格既不是锚也不是波，而是谎言。
modes.definition_en: The triple structure of price and value explains both why prices fluctuate and why they do not come apart. The gravitation mechanism is profit-rate arbitrage: when market price exceeds natural price, the excess profit draws capital and labour into the trade, supply swells, and price falls back; when it falls below, capital withdraws, supply contracts, and price recovers—the quantity brought to market 'naturally suits itself to the effectual demand,' in Smith's metaphor borrowed from the physical sciences. Three disciplines give the mode its force. First, separate the anchor from the noise: stratify the long-run cost structure (natural price) from short-term supply-demand fluctuations (market price), so one can judge which price signal is trustworthy and which is a temporary deviation—not every price movement carries information about value. Second, the executor of gravitation is the arbitrageur: price convergence is not the outcome of moral discipline but of every capitalist's ceaseless pursuit of advantage—he never employs his capital where he expects it to yield less; the market is cleared by the profit-seekers themselves, which means the mechanism needs free entry, not altruism. Third, gravitation can be damped or frozen: monopoly, trade secrets, blocked mobility of capital and labour, and regulation-induced scarcity all slow or suspend the return; Smith explicitly warns that under such conditions market price can be held above natural price 'for many years together.' A frozen price is therefore not an anchor and not a wave—it is a distortion wearing the costume of information. Signature: every price is a superposition of three layers—first ask how far it sits from its natural price and whether the arbitrage channel is open, and only then decide whether to read it as signal or as noise; a price frozen by monopoly is neither anchor nor fluctuation but a lie.
modes.source_chapter: 《国富论》第一卷第七章 'Of the Natural and Market Price of Commodities'
process_zh: 核算自然价：按土地地租、劳动工资、资本利润的自然率分解商品长期成本，确定中心价格带
测量市价偏离：比较实际成交价与自然价带的偏离方向与幅度，区分有效需求变化与临时扰动
检查套利通道：核对进入壁垒、资本与劳动流动性、信息透明度，判断引力机制是否畅通
按分层定价决策：把畅通引力下的市价当真实信号，把被冻结的偏离价识别为扭曲而非价值
process_en: Compute the natural price: decompose long-run cost into rent, wages, and profit at natural rates to fix the central price band
Measure the deviation: compare transacted price with the natural band—direction and size—separating shifts in effectual demand from transient shocks
Check the arbitrage channel: audit entry barriers, mobility of capital and labour, and information transparency to see whether gravitation is running
Decide on the stratified price: treat market price under open gravitation as genuine signal; treat a frozen deviation as distortion, not value
representative_cases_zh: 19世纪美国小麦与铁路：小麦市价因歉收短暂飙升后，资本涌入耕作与运输，几年内供给扩张把价格拉回自然价附近——引力机制的教科书案例
航空业运力套利：某航线票价长期高于成本时，新航司涌入加密班次，票价回落至覆盖成本的自然价带；退出与进入两个方向都在上演
反例警示：租金管制的冻结——房租被行政钉在自然价之下，新供给因利润率不足而不来，'回归'永不发生，短缺以排队与黑市的形式表达；被冻结的价格不是稳定而是失真
反例警示：钻石垄断——戴比尔斯控制供给通道数十年，钻石市价长期悬于自然价之上不回归，证明引力需要竞争通道畅通

representative_cases_en.title: Wheat and railways
representative_cases_en.case: A harvest failure spikes wheat's market price; capital floods into farming and rail transport, and within a few seasons expanded supply pulls the price back toward its natural level—the textbook gravitation loop
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Where governments reacted to the same spike with export bans and price ceilings, the return never happened—the damped channel replaced convergence with queues and smuggling

representative_cases_en.title: Airline capacity arbitrage
representative_cases_en.case: When a route's fares sit durably above cost, entrants add frequencies and fares fall back into the natural band covering capital's return; exit does the same work in reverse
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Slots and bilateral airport agreements can freeze the channel: capacity-constrained hub fares stay above natural price for years, exactly Smith's 'many years together' warning

representative_cases_en.title: Rent control
representative_cases_en.case: In uncontrolled markets, rent follows construction costs and demand, and housing supply answers price the way capital answers profit
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Rent control pins market price below natural price; supply withholds because profit falls short, the return never occurs, and shortage expresses itself as queues and black markets—a frozen price is distortion, not stability

representative_cases_en.title: The De Beers diamond monopoly
representative_cases_en.case: Where the channel is open—synthetic and lab-grown stones today—diamond prices have begun gravitating down toward production cost
representative_cases_en.counter_case: For decades De Beers held supply off the market, keeping diamond prices suspended above natural price without return—proof gravitation requires an open competitive channel

modern_applications_zh: 投资估值锚定：以重置成本/长期成本结构估计证券'自然价'，把短期市价偏离当作均值回归机会而非趋势
反垄断经济学：并购审查的核心问题是'该交易是否冻结引力通道'——垄断的本质是让价格停止回归
平台定价监管：网约车、外卖动态定价监管须区分'供需波动'与'市场势力冻结'，只冻结后者
创业定价策略：新进入者以'低于自然价的渗透价'主动制造偏离，赌引力机制把规模与成本拉回盈利带
modern_applications_en: Valuation anchoring: estimate a security's natural price from replacement and long-run cost, treating short-term deviations as mean-reversion opportunities rather than trends
Antitrust economics: merger review asks one core question—does the deal freeze the gravitation channel, since monopoly is precisely the cessation of convergence
Platform pricing regulation: regulators of dynamic ride and delivery pricing must separate demand fluctuation from market-power freezing, and touch only the latter
Startup penetration pricing: entrants deliberately price below natural price to buy scale, betting gravitation will pull costs and volume back into a profitable band
modes.key_quote_zh: 自然价格仿佛是中心价格，一切商品的价格都不断受其引力而被拉向它。
modes.key_quote_en: The natural price is, as it were, the central price, to which the prices of all commodities are continually gravitating.

modes.name_zh: 同情共感与公正旁观者
modes.domain_zh: 道德哲学/道德判断机制
modes.domain_en: Moral Philosophy / Mechanism of Moral Judgment
modes.definition_zh: 把'道德判断从何而来'从'神授戒律或先天理性'改写为'想象中换位的情感校准机制'：人在想象中进入他人处境，核对彼此情感是否合拍（sympathy，同情共感）——合拍则赞许，不合拍则谴责；《道德情操论》开篇即言人的同情共感源于想象性的换位，'人若终其一生从未借他人之眼映照过自己的情感，将如生来失明者'。由于当事人的激情总强于旁观者所能共感的程度，人学会在想象中召唤一个'公正旁观者'，以第三方之眼审视自己的情感与行为，由此生成良心。要害有三：其一，道德是镜像而非戒律——自我判断依赖先被他人判断，'我以他人之眼审视自己'，良心的原材料是社会性映照；其二，公正旁观者提供升维标准——他剥离利益、地位与私谊，要求'以真正无偏旁观者的眼光看我'，这使道德判断可以独立于舆论与权力（多数人的喝彩不等于旁观者的首肯）；其三，同情共感有其失败模式——旁观者天然更同情富人与成功者（'钦佩富人与大人物、忽视穷人与小人物'的倾向）会系统性扭曲道德校准，斯密称之为道德情操腐败的最大而最普遍的原因。方法论签名：判断自己行为的唯一可靠席位在观众席上——先找到那个既非你的受益者、也非你敌人的旁观者席位，把他的眼睛借来照自己的激情，凡经不起公正旁观者注视的欲望，都不是你该服从的声音。
modes.definition_en: Sympathy and the impartial spectator rewrite where moral judgment comes from: not from divine command or innate rational law, but from an imaginative position-swap that calibrates feeling against feeling. Three disciplines give the mode its force. First, morality is a mirror, not a code: self-judgment presupposes having been judged by others—the self that condemns is constructed from the gaze of the world; a person who had never seen himself reflected in the sentiments of others would be, Smith argues, as blind to his own conduct as one born blind is to colour. Second, the impartial spectator supplies an upgrade path above public opinion: he strips out interest, rank, and friendship, demanding that we judge 'as another and impartial spectator would examine it'; this makes moral judgment independent of applause and power—the loudest crowd is not the same thing as the spectator's assent, and a corrupt age's applause is precisely what the internal spectator exists to refuse. Third, sympathy has systematic failure modes: spectators naturally admire the rich and the great and are cold toward the poor—'the disposition to admire the rich and the great, and to neglect persons of poor and mean condition'—which bends moral calibration toward status; Smith treats this deference as 'the great and most universal cause of the corruption of our moral sentiments,' which is why the method insists on auditing whose eye you are borrowing. Signature: the only reliable seat for judging your own conduct is in the audience—find the spectator who is neither your beneficiary nor your enemy, borrow his eyes to look at your passions, and whatever desire cannot survive his gaze is not a voice you should obey.
modes.source_chapter: 《道德情操论》(The Theory of Moral Sentiments, 1759/1790第六版) 第一卷第一篇第一至三章、第三卷 'Of Self-Command' 及第三篇关于公正旁观者诸章
process_zh: 换位想象：进入他人处境，逐项核对自己的情感反应与其情感是否合拍，标出不合拍点
检视旁观者席位：确认当前借用的眼光来自谁——利益相关者、权力者还是真正中立者，排除被地位光环污染的镜子
召唤公正旁观者：以完全无利益、无关系的第三方视角重新审视自己的激情与拟议行为
依据旁观者裁决行动：凡经不起旁观者注视的欲望降权，经得起者升格为可执行的决定
process_en: Swap positions in imagination: enter the other's situation and check whether your emotions beat time with theirs, marking every discordance
Audit the seat you are borrowing: identify whose eyes you are using—an interested party, the powerful, or a genuinely neutral gaze—and screen out mirrors polluted by rank
Summon the impartial spectator: re-examine your passions and the proposed conduct from a wholly disinterested third-party view
Let the spectator rule: down-weight desires that cannot survive his gaze; promote to decision those that can
representative_cases_zh: 普通人的日常羞耻机制：撒谎前先想象被朋友识破的表情，旁观者的目光在行为前就完成约束——良心是内化的旁观者，无需外部制裁已先行生效
苏格拉底之死：柏拉图与色诺芬笔下，苏格拉底拒绝逃亡所依据的不是雅典法庭的多数意见，而是'内心之人'（the man within the breast）的裁决——多数喝彩与旁观者首肯的分离
反例警示：群众道德的腐败——斯密专门分析'钦佩富人与大人物、忽视穷人与小人物'的倾向：人们把奢侈浪费当作美德来崇拜、把勤劳节俭当作卑贱，因为旁观者之眼被财富光环系统性污染；借错镜子比不照镜子更糟
反例警示：利益相关者的假共感——向只关心自身利益者寻求安慰，得到的'共情'实为谄媚，合拍是伪造的，旁观者席位被既得利益者占据

representative_cases_en.title: Everyday shame before the act
representative_cases_en.case: Before lying, we rehearse the friend's face catching us out; the spectator's gaze binds conduct before any external sanction arrives—conscience as an internalized audience
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Where a person's only mirror is a corrupt clique applauding the lie, the internalized spectator applauds too—social mirroring calibrates morality in whichever direction the mirrors point

representative_cases_en.title: Socrates refusing escape
representative_cases_en.case: In Plato and Xenophon, Socrates defies the assembled crowd by obeying 'the man within the breast'—the separation of majority applause from the impartial spectator's assent, two and a half centuries before Smith named it
representative_cases_en.counter_case: The Athenian jury itself is the counter-case: five hundred spectators whose judgment was bent by fear and demagogy—an external audience without an internal spectator produces legitimized injustice

representative_cases_en.title: The corruption of moral sentiments
representative_cases_en.case: Smith analyses the 'disposition to admire the rich and the great, and to neglect persons of poor and mean condition': luxury is worshipped as virtue while frugality is sneered at as meanness
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Because spectators' eyes are systematically tinted by wealth and rank, borrowing any popular mirror produces calibration toward status, not merit—a borrowed mirror, wrongly chosen, is worse than none

representative_cases_en.title: False sympathy of the interested
representative_cases_en.case: Consolation sought from someone who needs your favour yields 'empathy' that is flattery in costume—the concordance of feeling is faked, the spectator's seat occupied by a stakeholder
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Smith notes our tendency to unload griefs on whoever will listen—but an audience with a stake cannot supply the disinterested concordance that judgment requires

modern_applications_zh: 制度伦理设计：董事会与合规审查以'无利益独立席位'制度化公正旁观者，把道德判断与利益表决权分离
调解与仲裁：中立第三方通过还原双方处境促成情感合拍，先重建共感再谈条款
声誉与信用系统：评分机制把'他人眼光'规模化嵌入交易，用户在行为前预演旁观者之眼
领导力训练：决策前以'假如明早见报'或'写给最挑剔的批评者'仪式化召唤旁观者，对冲权力对自我判断的腐蚀
modern_applications_en: Institutional ethics: independent directors and compliance seats institutionalize the impartial spectator, splitting moral review from interested voting power
Mediation and arbitration: a neutral third party reconstructs each side's situation to restore concordance of feeling before terms are discussed
Reputation systems: rating mechanisms scale the 'eyes of others' into every transaction, letting users rehearse the spectator's gaze before acting
Leadership practice: ritualizing the spectator—'how would this read on the front page?'—counters the corrosion of power over self-judgment
modes.key_quote_zh: 我们以想象中公正旁观者审视自己行为的方式检视自己的行为——人心中那个人（the man within the breast），是良心的真正居所。
modes.key_quote_en: We examine our own conduct as we imagine any other fair and impartial spectator would examine it—the man within the breast is where conscience truly lives.

modes.name_zh: 有限政府与税赋四原则
modes.name_en: Limited Government and the Four Canons of Taxation
modes.definition_zh: 把'国家该做什么'从'权力范围之争'改写为'职能清单加税收约束的双重设计'：斯密把主权者义务限定为三项——保护社会不受暴力侵犯（国防）、保护每个成员不受其他成员压迫（司法）、建设并维护私人无力或不愿承办的公共工程与公共机构（公共品），即后世所称'守夜人国家'的原始版本；同时以税收四原则约束取财之道——公平（按能力比例纳税）、确定（税额、方式与时间必须明确不可恣意）、便利（在纳税人最方便的时间与方式征收）、经济（征管成本最小，'不得使人民荷包在税之外再多掏'）。要害有三：其一，职能与税制是一枚硬币——政府的边界由公共品的'私人无力承办'标准划出，而征税四原则保证国家取财不侵蚀市场赖以运行的激励与确定性，二者缺一即滑向重商主义式的掠夺性财政；其二，确定性是第一美德——斯密断言哪怕税负不轻，只要'确定'，其不平等尚可忍受，而'不确定的税收'使每个纳税人都任凭征税官吏恣意摆布，不确定本身就是暴政；其三，征管成本是隐形税负——繁琐稽查、迁延与刁难都让人民的实际负担远超国库所得，四原则把国家自己放进被审计的位置。方法论签名：先给国家开一张封闭的职能清单，再给国库装上四把锁——公平、确定、便利、经济，任何越过清单的野心或绕开锁的征课，都必须由主张者举证，而不是由纳税者忍受。
modes.definition_en: Limited government is designed as a double structure: a closed list of state functions plus a tax discipline that keeps the state's taking from destroying the market it protects. Against this boundary stands the taxation side, the four canons: equity (subjects contribute in proportion to their respective abilities, 'in proportion to the revenue which they respectively enjoy under the protection of the state'); certainty (the tax, its amount, the manner and time of payment, must be clear and plain, 'not arbitrary'); convenience (levied in the time and manner most likely to be convenient for the contributor); and economy (every tax ought to take out of people's pockets as little as possible over and above what it brings into the public treasury). Three disciplines give the mode its force. First, function and fiscal rule are one coin: the state's edge is drawn by the standard of what private capital cannot profitably provide, while the four canons guarantee that raising revenue does not corrode the incentives and certainty on which the market runs—drop either half and the state slides toward the predatory, mercantilist finance Smith spent Book V attacking. Second, certainty is the first virtue: Smith insists that 'a very considerable degree of inequality' may be endured, but 'arbitrariness is always great and intolerable'—an uncertain tax exposes every subject to the caprice of the tax-gatherer, and uncertainty is itself a form of tyranny, chilling investment more surely than a high but known rate. Third, collection cost is a hidden tax: vexatious visits, delays, and inspection apparatus make the people's real burden exceed the treasury's gain; the fourth canon is a demand that the state audit itself. Signature: hand the state a closed list of duties first, then lock the treasury with four locks—equity, certainty, convenience, economy—and let anyone who oversteps the list or picks a lock carry the burden of proof, not the taxed.
modes.source_chapter: 《国富论》第五卷第一篇 'Of the Expences of the Sovereign or Commonwealth'（国防、司法、公共工程三职能）及第五卷第二篇（税收四原则）
process_zh: 划定职能清单：以'私人资本是否愿意且能够承办'为筛，把国家职责封闭在国防、司法、公共工程三类之内
逐项设计筹资：对每项职能选择税种，核对其符合公平、确定、便利、经济四原则的程度
优先保证确定性：公布税基、税率、缴纳时间与方式并写入法典，压缩征管自由裁量
审计征管成本：测算纳税人实际负担与国库所得的差额，凡差额过大即重构征管流程
process_en: Draw the closed function list: screen every candidate duty by 'could private capital profitably provide it?' and confine the state to defence, justice, and public works
Design funding item by item: choose a tax for each function and score it against equity, certainty, convenience, and economy
Enshrine certainty first: publish the base, rate, timing, and mode of every tax in statute, squeezing discretionary room for the collector
Audit collection cost: measure the gap between taxpayers' real burden and treasury receipts, and redesign administration wherever the gap runs large
representative_cases_zh: 19世纪英国财政转型：1842年重启确定、公开的所得税，替代高度任意、被利益集团操纵的关税与消费税体系，税负确定后商业扩张反而扩大税基
新加坡与北欧的高确定性税制：税基、税率、缴纳流程完全公开且数字化，'确定性'与'便利'原则的实现使高税负国家仍保持高合规率——高税与暴政不是同义词
反例警示：法王路易十四至大革命前的包税人制度——税收被承包给私人且征收方式恣意，确定性与经济原则双双崩溃，纳税人实际负担数倍于国库所得，最终以革命方式清算；任意征课比重税更能压垮国家
反例警示：无限职能与有限税制的错配——若政府职能无限扩张却只依赖低效隐蔽税（通胀税、杂费），结果是既越过职能清单又破坏四原则，市场激励被双重侵蚀

representative_cases_en.title: Britain's fiscal transformation
representative_cases_en.case: Reviving a certain, published income tax in 1842 replaced arbitrary, interest-captured duties; once the burden was predictable, commercial expansion widened the base—fiscal discipline and growth reinforcing each other
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Wartime levies imposed without published rules in the 1790s chilled investment despite moderate nominal rates—uncertainty taxed more than the rate did

representative_cases_en.title: High-certainty tax states
representative_cases_en.case: Singapore and the Nordic countries publish base, rate, and procedure down to the digital interface; certainty and convenience delivered make high rates compatible with high compliance—high tax and tyranny are not synonyms
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Where filing is opaque and discretionary (informal levies in many economies), even low statutory rates coexist with evasion and grievance—the canons, not the rate, set compliance

representative_cases_en.title: The French tax farmers
representative_cases_en.case: From Louis XIV to the Revolution, collection was farmed to private financiers with arbitrary methods: certainty and economy both collapsed, the people's burden ran at multiples of treasury receipts, and the ledger was settled by revolution
representative_cases_en.counter_case: An arbitrary tax is a worse tax than a heavy one—the farm system destroyed the very state it was meant to feed

representative_cases_en.title: Unlimited functions, hidden finance
representative_cases_en.case: When a state expands functions without bound but funds them with hidden instruments (inflation, myriad fees), it breaches the closed list and the canons at once
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Market incentives are corroded twice—by the crowd-out of the overgrown state and by the invisible, unequal tax—exactly the mercantilist predation Smith's Book V was written against

modern_applications_zh: 预算与税制改革评估：任何新税或费以四原则打分（公平/确定/便利/经济），总分不达标即退回重设计
政府职能清单化：负面清单与'政府退出目录'以'私人资本能否承办'为筛，划定守夜人边界
营商环境评价：把'税制的确定性'（税负可预期、征管自由裁量空间）设为一级指标而非只看税率
数字经济税收：对平台与跨境数字服务征税先满足确定性与便利原则（如单一比例税率与代扣代缴），避免征管成本吞掉税基
modern_applications_en: Tax-reform appraisal: score every new tax or fee against the four canons—equity, certainty, convenience, economy—and send any low-scoring design back to the drawing board
Function-list governance: negative lists and 'state-exit catalogues' use the 'could private capital provide it?' screen to patrol the night-watchman boundary
Business-climate rankings: make tax certainty (predictable burden, narrow collector discretion) a first-class metric, not merely the headline rate
Digital-economy taxation: platform and cross-border digital levies should satisfy certainty and convenience by design (single rates, withholding at source) so collection cost never eats the base
modes.key_quote_zh: 不确定的税收纵非苛暴之极，也使每个纳税人任凭征税官吏的恣意摆布——税收的不确定本身就是一种暴政。
modes.key_quote_en: The uncertainty of taxation, though not the greatest of evils, exposes every subject to the insolence of the tax-gatherers—arbitrariness is always great and intolerable.

modes.name_zh: 自利与利他双层人性论
modes.name_en: Self-Interest and Benevolence: The Two-Layer Theory of Human Nature
modes.domain_en: Theory of Human Nature and Economic Sociology
modes.definition_zh: 斯密人性论的双层结构：在《国富论》中，经济行为以自利为动力——'我们的晚餐并非来自屠夫、酿酒师和面包师的恩惠，而是来自他们对自身利益的关切'；在《道德情操论》中，人又天然具有同情共感（sympathy），以'公正旁观者'为道德裁判。二者并非矛盾，而是同一人性在交易领域与道德领域的分层呈现：市场把自利聚合为公共善，道德把同情聚合为品格。三个要害：一、自利是分析交易秩序的起点而非人的全部——斯密从未说人是纯粹自利的动物，恩惠在家庭与友谊中真实运作，只是不能作为大规模协作的组织原则；二、'看不见的手'的聚合效果依赖制度前提，自利若无法治与竞争约束，会退化为掠夺而非互利；三、同情心随社会距离衰减，因此大社会的秩序不能托付于仁爱，必须托付于以自利为轮齿的分工交换系统。方法论签名句：先分清人性在哪一层运作，再选择用道德劝谕还是用制度设计去动员它——自利归市场，仁爱归私域，正义归法律。
modes.definition_en: Smith's theory of human nature is two-layered, not contradictory. In The Wealth of Nations, the moving spring of economic life is self-interest: 'It is not from the benevolence of the butcher, the brewer, or the baker, that we expect our dinner, but from their regard to their own interest' — address yourself to their self-love, never to your necessities but to their advantages. In The Theory of Moral Sentiments, however, the first fact of human psychology is sympathy: however selfish man may be supposed, 'there are evidently some principles in his nature, which interest him in the fortune of others.' The two books describe one human being in two registers. Second key: the aggregation of self-interest into public benefit is conditional, not automatic; the 'invisible hand' works because the merchant prefers domestic industry with face-to-face accountability, enforceable contracts, and competitive pressure; strip these away and self-interest degrades into monopoly, fraud, and plunder. Smith is no apologist for greed: TMS diagnoses the 'disposition to admire, and almost to worship, the rich and the powerful' as a deception of the imagination, policed by the 'impartial spectator.' Third key: institutional design must match the layer of human nature it mobilizes — asking the butcher for charity produces poverty; asking strangers for exchange produces abundance; relying on universal benevolence produces an empire of flies and gnats. Hence: first identify which layer of human nature operates in the domain, then choose whether to mobilize it by moral exhortation, market incentive, or legal justice — self-interest to the market, benevolence to the private sphere, justice to the law.
modes.source_chapter: WN I.2 (Of the Principle which gives Occasion to the Division of Labour); TMS I.1.1 (Of Sympathy); TMS IV.1.10 (Invisible Hand); TMS III (Conscience, Impartial Spectator)
process_zh: 识别行为领域的性质：是陌生人间的重复交易，还是熟人社会的互助网络
在交易域默认自利前提设计规则，在私域承认并保护仁爱与情感纽带
检验自利聚合是否有制度前提（法治、竞争、对称信息），缺失则干预或修法
用公正旁观者检验：该安排在无利害的旁观者眼中是否可辩护
process_en: Classify the behavioral domain: repeated exchange among strangers, or mutual aid within a face-to-face community
Default to self-interest when designing rules for the exchange domain; acknowledge and protect benevolence and affective bonds in the private sphere
Test whether the aggregation of self-interest has its institutional preconditions (rule of law, competition, symmetric information); where missing, intervene or reform the law
Apply the impartial-spectator test: would a disinterested observer find the arrangement defensible?
modes.famous_quote_zh: 我们的晚餐并非来自屠夫、酿酒师或面包师的恩惠，而是来自他们对自身利益的关切。
modes.famous_quote_en: It is not from the benevolence of the butcher, the brewer, or the baker, that we expect our dinner, but from their regard to their own interest.
modes.famous_quote_source: Adam Smith, An Inquiry into the Nature and Causes of the Wealth of Nations, Book I, Chapter 2 (1776)

representative_cases_zh.title: 维基百科：陌生人协作的仁爱成功例
representative_cases_zh.case: 维基百科由数百万陌生人免费供稿构成，看似证明'大规模利他协作'可行，突破了恩惠不可扩展的论断。
representative_cases_zh.counter_case: 反例：维基百科同时依赖明确的非市场制度设计——贡献者获得声誉回报、编辑仲裁机制防搭便车——一旦治理失效（恶意编辑、编辑战），协作即崩坏；单靠利他意愿无法维持。

representative_cases_zh.title: 高校教师参与匿名单盲评审
representative_cases_zh.case: 学术共同体中，教授无偿为同行论文做评审，靠声誉与互惠规范运转，这是利他在小规模、重复博弈社群中的真实运作。
representative_cases_zh.counter_case: 反例：一旦评审由本应互惠的人长期拒绝承担（搭便车），或审稿池仅靠极少数人支撑，制度退化为'感恩的奴隶'困境——仁爱不足以支撑大系统负载，期刊被迫引入激励或强制。

representative_cases_zh.title: 稻米价格上限与市场诚信
representative_cases_zh.case: famine 时期商人维持平价供应、民间义仓互助，说明灾变中同情心确能动员局部救济。
representative_cases_zh.counter_case: 反例：若把道德劝谕作为政策工具，要求粮商'凭良心'抑价，结果恰是斯密描述的：囤积避售、黑市滋生、短缺加剧——利他劝谕在大规模稀缺条件下系统性失灵。

representative_cases_zh.title: 保险联营中自利如何为群体买单
representative_cases_zh.case: 小额保险把自利（为自己投保）聚合为对陌生受灾者的真实赔付，说明自利机制能产生利他结果。
representative_cases_zh.counter_case: 反例：逆向选择——风险最高者最愿意投保、健康者退出——使池子崩塌，证明自利聚合需要制度前提（强制参保或风险定价），否则仁爱与自利都救不了市场。

representative_cases_en.title: Wikipedia: large-scale cooperation among strangers
representative_cases_en.case: Wikipedia is built by millions of strangers contributing for free — an apparent counterexample to Smith's claim that benevolence cannot scale to a great society.
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Counter-case: Wikipedia also depends on explicit non-market governance — reputation incentives, editorial arbitration against free-riding; when governance fails (vandalism, edit wars), cooperation collapses. Altruistic willingness alone does not sustain it.

representative_cases_en.title: Professors performing anonymous peer review
representative_cases_en.case: In academic communities, professors review papers for free, sustained by reputation and reciprocity norms — genuine benevolence operating in a small, repeated-game community.
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Counter-case: when expected reciprocity is chronically refused (free-riding) and the reviewer pool shrinks to a few overloaded individuals, the system degrades — journals are forced to introduce incentives or compulsion, proving benevolence cannot bear systemic load alone.

representative_cases_en.title: Grain merchants keeping prices fair in famine
representative_cases_en.case: During famines, merchants holding prices down and communal granaries providing relief show that sympathy genuinely mobilizes localized charity in crisis.
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Counter-case: when moral exhortation becomes policy — demanding merchants price 'in good conscience' — hoarding, black markets, and worsened shortages follow exactly as Smith predicted; altruistic exhortation fails systematically at scale.

representative_cases_en.title: Insurance pools: how self-interest pays strangers
representative_cases_en.case: Micro-insurance aggregates self-interest (insuring oneself) into genuine payouts to disaster-struck strangers — self-interest producing benevolent outcomes.
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Counter-case: adverse selection — the highest-risk individuals insure most eagerly while the healthy exit — collapses the pool, showing that aggregated self-interest needs institutional preconditions (mandates or risk pricing) before either benevolence or self-interest can save the market.

modern_applications_zh.app: 平台经济设计：外卖、打车平台的匹配机制以司机与骑手自利为轮齿，以评价与押金制度为约束，模拟斯密'自利+制度前提'的分工交换结构。
公益组织筹款：按社会距离衰减原理，把捐赠人对'可辨识个体'的同情（identifiable victim effect）转化为可持续机制，而非依赖抽象苦难的说服。
企业治理：把股东自利约束在'公正旁观者'检验内——ESG、声誉市场与董事会问责，正是防止自利退化为掠夺的制度化设计。
行为经济学政策：nudge 承认人性双层——用默认选项驾驭惰性与自利，同时保留 TMS 式的社会规范与荣誉激励，避免单向理性人假设。

modern_applications_en.app: Platform economy design: matching mechanisms in ride-hailing and delivery run on riders' and drivers' self-interest, constrained by ratings and deposits — a modern simulation of Smith's exchange-plus-institutions structure.

Charitable fundraising: following the social-distance decay of sympathy, convert donors' response to identifiable victims into sustainable mechanisms rather than relying on appeals to abstract suffering.

Corporate governance: constrain shareholder self-interest by the impartial-spectator test — ESG, reputational markets, and board accountability institutionalize the guardrails that keep self-interest from degrading into predation.

Behavioral public policy: nudge accepts the two-layer nature of humanity — steering inertia and self-interest with default options while retaining TMS-style social norms and honor incentives, avoiding a one-dimensional rational-actor premise.

modes.name_zh: 寻租批判与利益集团警示
modes.name_en: Critique of Rent-Seeking and the Merchants' Conspiracy Warning
modes.domain_zh: 政治经济学与公共政策
modes.definition_zh: 斯密对利益集团的批判是《国富论》的隐伏主线：同业者聚会必成对付公众的密谋，重商主义的特许公司、关税、行会与殖民地垄断，都是商人与制造商借立法之手把私利固化为租金。三个要害：一、利益集团捕获政策的过程常以'公共福祉'为修辞外衣——宣称雇用不起本国劳工、须以高关税保护，实为抬价牟利；二、政治分配权力本身就是可竞租的资源，立法越能干预经济，寻租的期望收益越高，聪明才智就从生产转向游说；三、反制之道不是消灭商业，而是拆租：贸易自由化、废除特许垄断、控制政治对经济租金的分配权。方法论签名句：每当一项'保护性'政策出台，先问租金流向谁的口袋，再问消费者与公众为此付出了什么。
modes.definition_en: The critique of organized producer interests is the hidden spine of The Wealth of Nations. Smith's warning is explicit: 'People of the same trade seldom meet together, even for merriment and diversion, but the conversation ends in a conspiracy against the public, or in some contrivance to raise prices.' He neither prohibits such meetings — no law can prevent people from sitting together — nor trusts the merchants' word; any proposal from this order 'ought always to be listened to with great precaution... with the most scrupulous, and with the most suspicious attention.' First key: rent-seeking travels in the costume of public welfare. Merchants claim they cannot employ national labour unless protected by duties and bounties, when their real interest is higher prices and restricted competition; Smith tolerates the Navigation Act as security policy but condemns the colonies-trade monopoly as pure privilege that 'deranges the distribution of the stock of society.' Second key: political power over economic allocation is itself a contestable prize — the more the legislature can redirect trade, grant charters, or license guilds, the higher the return to lobbying relative to production, diverting capital and intelligence from employing productive hands to courting privilege. Stigler's capture theory and Tullock's and Krueger's rent-seeking formalize this chapter directly. Third key: the remedy is not to abolish commerce but to dismantle rent — free trade, abolition of exclusive companies, and narrowing the government's power to confer privilege, which lowers the payoff to conspiracy rather than merely criminalizing it. Signature: whenever a 'protective' policy is proposed, first ask into whose pocket the rent will flow, and only then what consumers and the public must pay for it.
modes.source_chapter: WN I.10.c (Wages and Profit in the different Employments of Labour and Stock); WN I.11 (Rent of Land, conclusion); WN IV.2 & IV.7 (Restraints of Importation, Colonies); WN I.10.c.61 'People of the same trade...'
key_concepts: 同业密谋（conspiracy against the public）
process_zh: 识别政策提案的真实受益人：追踪租金最终流向哪些生产者集团
审查提案的修辞：'国家安全''扶持幼稚产业''保护劳工'背后的利益结构
比较寻租成本与生产成本：游说、牌照、配额消耗的资源是否本可创造价值
拆租优先于管制：扩大竞争与自由贸易，收紧政府授予权力的通道
process_en: Identify the true beneficiaries of a policy proposal: trace where the rent ultimately lands among producer groups
Audit the rhetoric: what interest structure hides behind 'national security', 'infant industry protection', or 'protecting workers'
Compare rent-seeking cost with production cost: are lobbying, licensing, and quotas consuming resources that could have created value
Dismantle rent before regulating it: widen competition and free trade, and narrow the government's channels for conferring privilege
modes.famous_quote_zh: 同行业的人即便为了消遣娱乐而聚会，交谈也常以对付公众的密谋或抬高价格的诡计告终。
modes.famous_quote_en: People of the same trade seldom meet together, even for merriment and diversion, but the conversation ends in a conspiracy against the public, or in some contrivance to raise prices.
modes.famous_quote_source: Adam Smith, An Inquiry into the Nature and Causes of the Wealth of Nations, Book I, Chapter X, Part II (1776)

representative_cases_zh.title: 东印度公司特许垄断
representative_cases_zh.case: 斯密直接点名东印度公司：特许贸易垄断使公司治理者用股东的钱经营自己的帝国，亏损归股东、暴利归官僚，是寻租的组织化标本。
representative_cases_zh.counter_case: 反例：特许公司在早期基础设施匮乏的阶段确曾高效开辟远洋航线、建立金融技术（股票、债券融资），若无垄断特许，高风险远洋资本或无人供给——垄断有时是高风险期融资的制度解决方案，而非单纯掠夺。

representative_cases_zh.title: 美国 sugar quota 制糖业配额
representative_cases_zh.case: 美国糖业配额长期使国内糖价高于世界价，消费者每年多付数十亿美元，集中于少数种植者家庭——教科书级的集中收益/分散成本寻租案例。
representative_cases_zh.counter_case: 反例：若配额真被废除，依赖糖价生存的小种植者社区可能整体破产，说明租金拆除有真实分配代价；斯密式拆租需配合过渡补偿，否则政治上不可行。

representative_cases_zh.title: 1970s 美国卡车运输业 ICC 管制
representative_cases_zh.case: ICC 表面是'安全与秩序'监管，实为运费卡特尔：路线与费率受管制，托运人支付超额运费——Stigler 捕获理论的经典证据，直至放松管制运费大降。
representative_cases_zh.counter_case: 反例：放松管制后也出现超载、司机疲劳、工资下降与安全事故回升，说明'拆租'未必带来全要素改进——自由化与安全规制的边界本身仍是待权衡的政策问题。

representative_cases_zh.title: 欧盟 CAP 农业补贴
representative_cases_zh.case: 共同农业政策最初以'粮食安全'之名建立价格支持，实则把预算大头导向大土地所有者，是斯密'地主从不劳动却处处受益'论断的现代版。
representative_cases_zh.counter_case: 反例：CAP 改革后转向生态与农村发展支付，部分补贴确实购买了公共品（生物多样性、景观维护）——说明'补贴=寻租'并非普遍真理，关键在支付是否对应真实公共品供给。

representative_cases_en.title: The East India Company's charter monopoly
representative_cases_en.case: Smith names the East India Company directly: its trade monopoly let its managers run a private empire with shareholders' money — losses to the shareholders, spoils to the bureaucracy — an organizational specimen of rent-seeking.
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Counter-case: charter companies did efficiently open oceanic routes and invent financial technology (joint-stock equity, bond finance) in an era of missing infrastructure; without exclusive charters, high-risk long-distance capital might not have been supplied at all — monopoly can be an institutional solution to financing high-risk frontiers.

representative_cases_en.title: The US sugar quota program
representative_cases_en.case: US sugar quotas have long kept domestic prices above world levels, costing consumers billions per year concentrated on a few grower families — a textbook case of concentrated benefits and diffuse costs.
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Counter-case: abolishing the quota outright could bankrupt whole grower communities dependent on protected prices; rent demolition carries real distributional costs and needs transition compensation to be politically feasible.

representative_cases_en.title: ICC regulation of US trucking (1935-1980)
representative_cases_en.case: The ICC, nominally a 'safety and order' regulator, functioned as a freight cartel: routes and rates were administered, shippers paid supranormal rates — classic evidence for Stigler's capture theory, until deregulation slashed freight prices.
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Counter-case: deregulation also brought overloading, driver fatigue, falling wages, and rising accident rates — showing that 'dismantling rent' does not guarantee across-the-board improvement; the boundary between liberalization and safety regulation remains a genuine policy tradeoff.

representative_cases_en.title: The EU Common Agricultural Policy
representative_cases_en.case: CAP was founded in the name of 'food security' with price supports that steered most of the budget to large landowners — the modern incarnation of Smith's dictum that landlords never labor yet everywhere benefit.
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Counter-case: post-reform CAP payments for ecology and rural development do purchase some genuine public goods (biodiversity, landscape) — 'subsidy equals rent-seeking' is not universally true; what matters is whether payments correspond to real public-good provision.

modern_applications_zh.app: 反垄断与平台治理：识别平台以'生态安全'为名的排他协议、自我优待与数据封锁，是斯密'同业密谋'在算法时代的直接延伸。
牌照经济审计：职业资格、网约车牌照、租赁管制等准入限制，每一条都值得追问'谁受益、消费者付了什么'，用斯密式怀疑审查代替默认信任。
游说与旋转门监管：公开游说账目、限制离任官员立即进入被监管行业，降低寻租期望收益，从源头而非事后打击利益集团。
产业政策设计：以'幼稚产业保护'为名的补贴需内置日落条款与绩效审计，防止保护常态化为永久租金——斯密对 bounty 的批评仍是模板。

modern_applications_en.app: Antitrust and platform governance: exclusive dealing, self-preferencing, and data walls justified as 'ecosystem security' extend Smith's merchants' conspiracy into the algorithmic age.

Licensing audits: every entry restriction — professional credentials, ride-hailing caps, rent control — deserves the Smithian question 'who benefits, and what do consumers pay', replacing default trust with suspicious attention.

Lobbying and revolving-door rules: disclosure of lobbying accounts and cooling-off periods for departing regulators lower the expected return to rent-seeking, attacking interest groups at the source rather than after the fact.

Industrial policy design: subsidies in the name of infant-industry protection should carry sunset clauses and performance audits, so temporary protection cannot harden into permanent rent — Smith's critique of bounties remains the template.

modes.name_zh: 系统构建与思想实验法
modes.domain_en: Philosophy of Science and Theory Construction
modes.definition_zh: 斯密在《天文学史》中把哲学定义为'关于连接原则的科学之史'：科学不是事实的堆叠，而是想象力的系统——用一套内在连贯的原理，把原本分散、异质、令人不安的现象连成一幅有秩序的图景，从而平息好奇心与惊奇。他自称沿用牛顿方法：从最简明的单因假设出发（分工、同情），推演出复杂现象，再以观测校准。三个要害：一、系统的价值在于连接力而非穷尽性——一个把万有引力推到木星卫星的原理，优于十万个观测记录；二、思想实验是系统构建的廉价引擎——'灯塔国''被注视的岩石'等假想情境让人分离出单一机制；三、系统必须保持可修订性：斯密明言每个系统都是想象力的产物，终将被更简明的系统取代，因此对自家体系也应保持批评距离。方法论签名句：先把分散的现象连成一个想象系统，再用观测苛待它——能被修正的系统才配称为科学。
modes.definition_en: Smith's essay 'The History of Astronomy' contains his explicit philosophy of science: philosophy is 'the science of the connecting principles of nature,' born of wonder at disjointed, anomalous phenomena that unsettle the imagination. A scientific system is 'an imaginary machine' — like a watch — whose parts are so adjusted that once set in motion they reproduce the observed regularities; its ideal is the Newtonian method, 'to introduce order and coherence' by tracing all phenomena from a single, simple, familiar principle, as Newton derived planets, comets, and tides from universal gravitation. First key: a system's value lies in its connecting power, not its exhaustiveness — one principle that carries from the apple to the moons of Jupiter beats ten thousand unconnected observations; Smith applied this to his own work, making the division of labour in WN and sympathy in TMS each a single spring from which heterogeneous phenomena move together. Third key: every system is provisional and must remain criticizable. Smith warns that admiration for a system's ingenuity can degenerate into the 'spirit of system' — the man of system 'so enamoured of the supposed beauty of his own ideal plan' that he forgets the real people on the chessboard — and each age's best system, Ptolemy's, Copernicus's, or Newton's, will be superseded; his own letters urging revision of WN's America chapters show the discipline applied to himself. Signature: first connect scattered phenomena into an imaginary system, then torment that system with observation — only a system that can be corrected deserves to be called science.
modes.source_chapter: The History of Astronomy, Sect. II-IV (Wonder, Surprise, Admirable Systems; Newtonian system); WN Introd. & Plan; TMS VI.ii.2.17 (Man of System); Essays on Philosophical Subjects
key_concepts: 惊奇与好奇心（wonder, surprise, admiration）
系统精神之危险（man of system）
process_zh: 从惊奇出发：找出令想象力不安的分散现象或反常
构造最简明的单一连接原理，用思想实验隔离单一机制做思想推演
把原理推演至远端领域，检验其连接力（从一个苹果到木星卫星）
以观测校准并保持系统可修订性，警惕'系统精神'凌驾真实的人
process_en: Begin from wonder: locate scattered phenomena or anomalies that unsettle the imagination
Construct the simplest single connecting principle, using thought experiments to isolate one mechanism for mental derivation
Extend the principle to distant domains to test its connecting power — from one apple to the moons of Jupiter
Calibrate against observation, keep the system revisable, and guard against the 'spirit of system' overriding real people
modes.famous_quote_zh: 哲学是对自然连接原则的探究——是关于连接原则的科学之史。
modes.famous_quote_en: Philosophy is the science of the connecting principles of nature.
modes.famous_quote_source: Adam Smith, 'The History of Astronomy', in Essays on Philosophical Subjects (1795, posthumous)

representative_cases_zh.title: 分工原理作为 WN 的连接原则
representative_cases_zh.case: 斯密以制针工厂一个观察为起点，把分工推演为劳动生产率、市场规模、货币起源、国际贸易的单一连接原理——教科书级的系统构建。
representative_cases_zh.counter_case: 反例：分工推演的远端链条（市场规模决定分工深度）并非普适——技术密集型产业分工深度主要由知识而非市场决定，杨格定理之后的内生增长理论必须修订该系统而非照搬。

representative_cases_zh.title: 天文学史中的托勒密-哥白尼-牛顿序列
representative_cases_zh.case: 斯密把三大天文系统按'连接力与简洁度'排序，示范了系统演化史观：每个系统都更连贯、更简洁，也终将被取代。
representative_cases_zh.counter_case: 反例：仅按简洁度评价系统会误判——地心说在观测精度上其实长期优于早期日心说，说明'更简洁的系统'未必立刻'更真实'，观测校准滞后于理论简洁性。

representative_cases_zh.title: 博弈论与经济学中的思想实验（如囚徒困境、热台实验）
representative_cases_zh.case: 囚徒困境是斯密式思想实验的现代范本：把自利聚合的边界条件剥离到纯粹情境，暴露出制度设计的必要性。
representative_cases_zh.counter_case: 反例：过度抽象的思想实验可能脱离真实约束——纯粹的理性人假设在神经经济学中被证伪（情感参与决策），说明思想实验必须与实证回环，否则系统沦为'想象机器'的自我循环。

representative_cases_zh.title: 经济学的因果推断革命（RCT 与自然实验）
representative_cases_zh.case: Banerjee-Duflo 的随机对照试验把斯密'用观测苛待系统'的训诫操作化：先有理论系统，再用田野实验苛待它。
representative_cases_zh.counter_case: 反例：RCT 只能回答局部因果，无法替代系统层面的连接原理——微观有效的干预加总未必改善宏观结果（如小额信贷的总体效应弱于微观估计），单一方法不足以支撑系统。

representative_cases_en.title: The division of labour as WN's connecting principle
representative_cases_en.case: Starting from one pin factory observation, Smith derives productivity, market size, the origin of money, and international trade from a single connecting principle — a textbook system construction.
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Counter-case: the far end of the chain (market size determines division of labour) is not universal — in knowledge-intensive industries, specialization depth is driven mainly by knowledge, not market extent; endogenous growth theory after Young had to revise rather than copy the system.

representative_cases_en.title: The Ptolemy-Copernicus-Newton sequence in the Astronomy essay
representative_cases_en.case: Smith ranks the three astronomical systems by connecting power and simplicity, demonstrating a history-of-systems view: each is more coherent and simpler, and each will be superseded.
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Counter-case: judging systems by simplicity alone misleads — geocentrism long outperformed early heliocentrism on observational fit, showing that a 'simpler system' is not immediately a 'truer' one; empirical calibration lags theoretical elegance.

representative_cases_en.title: Thought experiments in game theory (Prisoner's Dilemma)
representative_cases_en.case: The Prisoner's Dilemma is the modern exemplar of Smithian thought experimentation: it strips the boundary conditions of aggregated self-interest to a pure setting, exposing the necessity of institutional design.
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Counter-case: over-abstracted thought experiments can drift from real constraints — pure rational-actor assumptions are falsified by neuroeconomics (emotion participates in choice); thought experiments must loop back to evidence or the system becomes a self-circling imaginary machine.

representative_cases_en.title: The causal-inference revolution in economics (RCTs)
representative_cases_en.case: Banerjee and Duflo's randomized controlled trials operationalize Smith's command to torment systems with observation: build a theoretical system first, then test it hard in the field.
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Counter-case: RCTs answer only local causal questions and cannot replace system-level connecting principles — micro-effective interventions need not aggregate into macro improvement (microfinance's total effects fall short of micro estimates); a single method cannot carry a system.

modern_applications_zh.app: 跨学科建模：把经济、生物、认知系统各自的最简连接原理并置比较，寻找同构机制（如竞争、选择、适应），是斯密系统构建法的当代形态。
AI 与机器学习：用大模型的涌现行为检验'简单原理产生复杂秩序'的假设，同时警惕把模型当作不可修订的完美系统——斯密的系统可修订性训诫直接适用。
战略咨询与情景规划：构造极端思想实验（黑天鹅、压力测试）隔离单一风险机制，替代直觉判断，是思想实验法在企业决策中的直接移植。
科学写作与科普：从单一个体可感的惊奇出发（一滴水、一枚针），把复杂理论还原为可想象的连接链条，是斯密'想象机器'修辞学的延续。

modern_applications_en.app: Interdisciplinary modeling: placing the simplest connecting principles of economic, biological, and cognitive systems side by side to seek isomorphic mechanisms (competition, selection, adaptation) is Smith's system-building in contemporary form.

AI and machine learning: testing the hypothesis that simple principles yield complex order against emergent behavior in large models, while refusing to treat any model as an unrevisable perfect system — Smith's revisability discipline applies directly.

Strategy consulting and scenario planning: constructing extreme thought experiments (black swans, stress tests) to isolate single risk mechanisms is a direct transplant of the method into corporate decision-making.

Science writing and popularization: starting from a wonder anyone can feel — a drop of water, a pin — and unfolding a complex theory into an imaginable chain of connections continues Smith's rhetoric of the imaginary machine.

modes.name_zh: 生产力-资本积累-制度演进框架
modes.domain_zh: 增长理论与制度经济学
modes.definition_zh: 斯密是第一个系统化增长模型的经济学家：分工提高劳动生产率，生产率剩余转化为储蓄，储蓄积累为资本，资本扩大可雇用的生产性劳动者，进而深化分工——一个自我强化的增长回路；但回路能否运转取决于制度环境：'和平、简便的赋税、过得去的司法'（peace, easy taxes, tolerable justice），加上自由港与自由贸易，其余交给自然进程。三个要害：一、增长的引擎是生产性劳动与储蓄，不是贵金属——重商主义把财富等同于金银，斯密把财富等同于年产出流；二、资本积累受'生产性/非生产性劳动'比例约束，政府若大规模雇用非生产性劳动，即抽走积累燃料；三、制度不是外生背景而是增长的第五要素——司法不公使商业萎缩，赋税苛扰使资本外逃，肯尼迪法令与《杰富法》之类反复重申：一国从最野蛮到最富足，只需和平、低税与过得去的司法，其余皆自然而至。方法论签名句：把增长拆为生产率、积累、制度三层后，先修制度地基，再谈引擎轰鸣。
modes.definition_en: Smith built the first systematic growth model in economics. Its engine is a self-reinforcing loop: the division of labour raises productivity; the surplus becomes saving; saving accumulates as capital; capital hires more productive labourers; a larger working population deepens the division of labour — and the circle turns again. 'Capitals are increased by parsimony': frugality, not prodigality, feeds the fund that employs productive hands. But the loop runs only inside an institutional envelope, stated as a maxim in his 1755 lectures and echoed in WN IV.9: 'Little else is requisite to carry a state to the highest degree of opulence from the lowest barbarism, but peace, easy taxes, and a tolerable administration of justice; all the rest being brought about by the natural course of things... any government which endeavours to go further is at once a most oppressive and a most intolerable tyranny.' First key: the engine of growth is productive labour and saving, not precious metals; against mercantilism, wealth is the flow of annual produce, not bullion — gold and silver are merely the wheel of circulation, and a country rich in mines can remain poor in real opulence. Third key: institutions are the fifth factor, not exogenous backdrop. Injustice 'pars down' commerce: insecure property makes capital flee, arbitrary or vexatious taxes discourage industry more than their amount, partial justice drives merchants into conspiracy with power. Smith's institutional minimalism is a growth-accounting claim, not laissez-faire romanticism: secure property, light and predictable taxes, and tolerable courts are preconditions without which parsimony is irrational and the accumulation engine stalls. Signature: decompose growth into productivity, accumulation, and institutions — repair the institutional foundation first, then speak of the engine's roar.
modes.source_chapter: WN I.1-3 (Division of Labour, Market Extent); WN II.3 (Productive and Unproductive Labour; Parsimony); WN IV.9 (Agricultural Systems; 'peace, easy taxes, tolerable justice' maxim); Lectures on Jurisprudence (1755 maxim)
key_concepts: 分工与生产率（division of labour, productivity）
和平、简便赋税、过得去的司法
process_zh: 核算增长的来源：区分生产率提升、要素积累与制度环境三层贡献
追踪储蓄-投资链条：剩余是否流向雇用生产性劳动的资本
审计制度地基：产权安全、税负简便、司法可预期性是否齐备
按'最薄弱环节'排序改革：先修司法与税制，再谈刺激与补贴
process_en: Decompose the sources of growth: separate productivity gains, factor accumulation, and the institutional environment
Trace the saving-investment chain: does the surplus flow into capital that employs productive labour
Audit the institutional foundation: are property security, light taxes, and predictable justice all in place
Rank reforms by weakest link: repair justice and taxation first, then discuss stimulus and subsidies
modes.famous_quote_zh: 使一国从最野蛮状态升至最富足境地的，几乎只需和平、简便的赋税与过得去的司法，其余一切皆由事物的自然进程带来。
modes.famous_quote_en: Little else is requisite to carry a state to the highest degree of opulence from the lowest barbarism, but peace, easy taxes, and a tolerable administration of justice; all the rest being brought about by the natural course of things.
modes.famous_quote_source: Adam Smith, Lectures on Jurisprudence (1755 maxim, reported by Dugald Stewart); echoed in WN IV.9 (1776)

representative_cases_zh.title: 中国 1978 后改革开放
representative_cases_zh.case: 产权安全化（家庭联产承包）、税负简化、司法可预期性提升，释放了数亿劳动者的生产性劳动——斯密增长回路在超大规模人口上的验证。
representative_cases_zh.counter_case: 反例：单纯'低税+开放'不足以解释后续增长——金融抑制、户籍约束与资本配置扭曲至今拖累全要素生产率，说明制度地基中的某一块缺失就会限制回路转速。

representative_cases_zh.title: 津巴布韦 2000 后土地改革
representative_cases_zh.case: 和平与产权同时崩塌：强征农场、司法工具化、恶性通胀，使曾号称'非洲粮仓'的农业产出暴跌——制度地基坍塌反噬增长的完整标本。
representative_cases_zh.counter_case: 反例：土地再分配本身有真实的分配正义理由（殖民遗留的极端集中），问题不在目标而在手段——破坏产权执行的制度土壤，任何分配目标都无法弥补增长引擎熄火。

representative_cases_zh.title: 北欧高税但高增长悖论
representative_cases_zh.case: 瑞典、丹麦税率远高于斯密时代，却长期保持高生产率与高创新能力，似乎反驳'easy taxes'的条件。
representative_cases_zh.counter_case: 反例：北欧税制虽高但简便、可预期、执行统一，且配套世界一流的司法与低腐败——满足的是斯密命题的实质（可预期性与公正），而非字面的'低税率'，说明命题应读作制度质量命题。

representative_cases_zh.title: 韩国 1960s-1990s 出口导向积累
representative_cases_zh.case: 高储蓄率把剩余转化为大规模工业资本，分工随出口市场扩展而深化——生产率、积累、开放市场三环齐动的斯密式增长。
representative_cases_zh.counter_case: 反例：财阀制度造成政企勾结与租金集中，1997 年金融危机暴露治理短板——积累引擎高速运转不等于制度地基健康，缺一块司法与公司治理的地基就会在危机中断裂。

representative_cases_en.title: China's reform and opening after 1978
representative_cases_en.case: Securing land-use rights (household responsibility system), simplifying taxation, and improving predictability released the productive labour of hundreds of millions — the Smithian growth loop verified at continental scale.
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Counter-case: 'low taxes plus openness' alone cannot explain the record — financial repression, hukou constraints, and capital-allocation distortions still drag total factor productivity, showing that one missing institutional block limits the loop's speed.

representative_cases_en.title: Zimbabwe's land reform after 2000
representative_cases_en.case: Peace and property collapsed together: farm expropriations, weaponized courts, and hyperinflation cratered agricultural output in the self-styled 'breadbasket of Africa' — a complete specimen of institutional collapse devouring growth.
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Counter-case: land redistribution itself had genuine distributive-justice grounds (colonially concentrated ownership); the failure lay in the means — destroying the institutional soil in which property is enforced cannot be offset by any distributional goal once the growth engine stalls.

representative_cases_en.title: The Nordic high-tax high-growth paradox
representative_cases_en.case: Sweden and Denmark tax far above Smith's era yet sustain high productivity and innovation, apparently refuting the 'easy taxes' condition.
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Counter-case: Nordic taxes are high but simple, predictable, and uniformly enforced, paired with first-rate courts and low corruption — satisfying the substance of Smith's condition (predictability and fairness) rather than its literal letter; the maxim reads as an institutional-quality claim.

representative_cases_en.title: Korea's export-led accumulation, 1960s-1990s
representative_cases_en.case: High savings converted surplus into industrial capital at scale while specialization deepened with export markets — productivity, accumulation, and open markets turning together in Smithian fashion.
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Counter-case: the chaebol system bred state-business collusion and concentrated rents, and the 1997 crisis exposed governance deficits — a fast-running accumulation engine is not the same as healthy institutional foundations, and a missing piece of judicial and corporate governance snaps under stress.

modern_applications_zh.app: 增长核算与生产率研究：Solow 残差、全要素生产率测算延续斯密'把产出分解为生产率与要素'的框架，是宏观增长研究的标准工具。
营商环境与制度评级：世界银行 Doing Business、司法独立性指数，把'peace, easy taxes, tolerable justice'操作化为可比较的跨国指标。
储蓄率与资本形成政策：养老金、税制设计引导家庭储蓄流向生产性投资，直接对应斯密'节俭积累是生产性劳动基金'的命题。
发展经济学结构转型：从农业到制造业再到服务业的分工深化路径分析，沿袭斯密'市场规模决定分工深度'的演化逻辑。

modern_applications_en.app: Growth accounting and productivity research: Solow residuals and total-factor-productivity measurement extend Smith's decomposition of output into productivity and factors — the standard toolkit of macro-growth research.

Business-climate and institutional ratings: World Bank governance indicators and judicial-independence indices operationalize 'peace, easy taxes, tolerable justice' into comparable cross-country metrics.

Savings and capital-formation policy: pension and tax design channels household saving into productive investment, directly applying Smith's proposition that parsimony is the fund of productive labour.

Structural transformation in development economics: analyses of specialization deepening from agriculture to manufacturing to services inherit Smith's logic that the extent of the market governs the division of labour.

modes.name_zh: 自利聚合的边界条件与政府职能
modes.name_en: Boundary Conditions of Aggregated Self-Interest and the Role of Government
modes.domain_zh: 公共经济学与国家理论
modes.domain_en: Public Economics and the Theory of the State
modes.definition_zh: 斯密不是放任主义者：他明确划定'自然自由体系'的边界，在边界内自利聚合近乎自动，边界之外必须由主权者补位——国防、司法、公共工程与公共机构（含教育）、以及维持君主尊严的收入。三个要害：一、市场失灵的原始清单由斯密开出——商人利益天然反对公共利益并使垄断倾向化、灯塔与道路等私利无法融资的公共品、儿童教育因父母短视与外部性而投资不足；二、 Progress of Opulence 本身有限度：分工受市场广度限制，殖民地垄断'使社会资本的分配偏离自然轨道'，增长路径可以被政治扭曲乃至锁定在次优轨道；三、政府职能的划定是边际问题而非原则问题——'看得见的手'该在何处介入，取决于哪项制度失灵、何种干预成本低、以及干预本身不被捕获的概率。方法论签名句：自利聚合的边界在哪里，政府的职责清单就从哪里开始——先证明市场失灵，再证明干预有效，两证俱全方可伸手。
modes.definition_en: Smith is not a doctrinaire laissez-faire thinker. The system of natural liberty has explicit boundaries, and where they end the sovereign's duties begin: protecting society from violence and invasion; protecting every member from injustice or oppression through 'an exact administration of justice'; and 'the duty of erecting and maintaining certain public works and certain public institutions, which it can never be for the interest of any individual, or small number of individuals, to erect and maintain; because the profit could never repay the expense to any individual or small number of individuals, though it may frequently do much more than repay it to a great society.' First key: Smith drew the original catalogue of market failure. Merchants' interest is 'always in some respects different from, and even opposite to, that of the public,' so their proposals must be heard with suspicious attention — an early statement of monopoly tendency and capture; roads, bridges, and canals 'cannot be maintained by any private person,' and though Smith prefers user-fee financing (turnpikes, light dues), the light of a lighthouse cannot reasonably be charged to individual ships, so general revenue must fund it. Third key: the Progress of Opulence has limits, and politics can distort or lock in inferior paths — the colony trade monopoly 'deranges the distribution of the stock of society,' pushing capital where it would not naturally flow, 'evidently hurtful to the great society.' The boundary of government is a marginal question, not a principle question. Signature: the catalogue of government begins exactly where the boundary of aggregated self-interest ends — first prove market failure, then prove effective intervention, and only with both proofs in hand may the state act.
modes.source_chapter: WN IV.9.51 (System of Natural Liberty, sovereign's three duties); WN V.1 (Public Works, Institutions, Education); WN V.1.f (Youth and Religious Instruction); WN III (Progress of Opulence); WN IV.7.b (Colony trade monopoly deranges capital allocation)
key_concepts: 教育外部性与公共教育
process_zh: 界定市场边界：逐项检验交易是否满足竞争、对称信息、无外部性前提
证明失灵：给出该领域自利聚合不足的具体机制（公共品、垄断、外部性、信息不对称）
证明干预有效且不被捕获：比较干预成本、政府能力与被利益集团劫持的风险
优先选择市场近似方案：使用者付费、可执行的产权、竞争性供给先于直接政府供给
process_en: Delimit the market boundary: test each domain against competition, symmetric information, and the absence of externalities
Prove the failure: specify the concrete mechanism of inadequate self-aggregation (public goods, monopoly, externalities, information asymmetry)
Prove the intervention is effective and not captured: compare intervention costs, state capacity, and the risk of capture by interest groups
Prefer market-like remedies first: user fees, enforceable property rights, and competitive provision before direct state supply
modes.famous_quote_zh: 一切特惠或限制的制度一经完全废止，最明白最单纯的自然自由体系便会自行确立……君主从此摆脱监督私人产业的义务，只尽三重职责。
modes.famous_quote_en: All systems either of preference or of restraint, therefore, being thus completely taken away, the obvious and simple system of natural liberty establishes itself of its own accord... the sovereign is completely discharged from a duty... of superintending the industry of private people.
modes.famous_quote_source: Adam Smith, An Inquiry into the Nature and Causes of the Wealth of Nations, Book IV, Chapter IX (1776)

representative_cases_zh.title: Coase 灯塔论文与公共品供给
representative_cases_zh.case: Coase 1974 年考证英国灯塔史上大量由私人以港口费融资供给，被广泛引用为'政府不必提供灯塔'的证据，是市场失灵清单的著名反例。
representative_cases_zh.counter_case: 反例：Van Zandt 与后续学者指出 Coase 忽略了强制收费权（领港公会用法定权力收税）——私人供给依然依赖国家强制执行，灯塔案例实际上更支持斯密'收益无法由个体回收时须公共融资'的原初判断。

representative_cases_zh.title: 新加坡组屋与强制公积金制度
representative_cases_zh.case: 政府在住房与储蓄领域大规模介入，但通过市场化的定价、产权与竞争性承包执行——'证明失灵+证明有效'两证俱全的干预范本。
representative_cases_zh.counter_case: 反例：同一模式移植到缺乏司法能力的国家常退化为分配寻租与烂尾工程，说明干预有效性的第二个证明（政府能力与不被捕获）比第一个证明更难满足。

representative_cases_zh.title: 义务教育普及与人力资本外部性
representative_cases_zh.case: 19 世纪普鲁士、日本、美国的强制义务教育，直接对应斯密'政府须防止分工使底层变愚'的论断，投资回报通过公民能力与增长长期兑现。
representative_cases_zh.counter_case: 反例：义务教育投入若脱离质量与问责，产出的是文凭通胀而非人力资本——证明干预的第三步（效果评估）不可省略，公共支出本身不构成对失灵的治愈。

representative_cases_zh.title: 《谢尔曼法》与平台反垄断
representative_cases_zh.case: 标准石油、AT&T 与当代平台案例，把斯密'商人利益天然反对公共利益'的警示转化为可执行的竞争法，防止垄断倾向锁定。
representative_cases_zh.counter_case: 反例：反垄断执法也可能被竞争对手操纵为'以诉代竞'的工具（诉讼游说、专利流氓式维权），说明干预自身存在被捕获的第三类风险，需以程序与透明度约束执法。

representative_cases_en.title: Coase's lighthouse paper and public-goods supply
representative_cases_en.case: Coase's 1974 study showed many English lighthouses were privately financed through port dues — widely cited as evidence that the state need not provide lighthouses, a famous counterexample to the market-failure catalogue.
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Counter-case: Van Zandt and later scholars showed Coase overlooked the compulsory collection power (Trinity House's statutory right to levy) — private provision still relied on state coercion, so the lighthouse case in fact supports Smith's original judgment that when benefits cannot be recovered by individuals, general revenue must fund them.

representative_cases_en.title: Singapore's public housing and provident fund
representative_cases_en.case: Massive state intervention in housing and saving, executed through market pricing, property rights, and competitive contracting — a paradigm of intervention with both proofs in hand: failure demonstrated, effectiveness demonstrated.
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Counter-case: the same model transplanted to states lacking judicial capacity degrades into allocative rent-seeking and unfinished projects — the second proof (state capacity and non-capture) is harder to satisfy than the first.

representative_cases_en.title: Compulsory schooling and human-capital externalities
representative_cases_en.case: Nineteenth-century Prussia, Japan, and the US institutionalized compulsory education, directly answering Smith's claim that government must prevent the division of labour from stunting the lower ranks, with returns realized through civic capacity and long-run growth.
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Counter-case: schooling spending divorced from quality and accountability produces credential inflation rather than human capital — the third step (evaluation of effects) cannot be skipped; public expenditure is not itself a cure for failure.

representative_cases_en.title: The Sherman Act and platform antitrust
representative_cases_en.case: Standard Oil, AT&T, and contemporary platform cases translated Smith's warning that merchants' interest is opposite to the public's into enforceable competition law, preventing monopoly tendency from locking in.
representative_cases_en.counter_case: Counter-case: antitrust enforcement can itself be weaponized by rivals as litigation-by-competition (strategic suits, patent-troll-style claims) — revealing a third risk of capture in the intervention itself, to be contained by procedure and transparency.

modern_applications_zh.app: 公共品融资设计：灯塔、基础研究、疾控预警等正外部性领域，按斯密标准先证个体回收不可能，再选择税收、使用者费或混合融资。
教育政策：把基础义务教育的公共供给与职业培训的市场竞争分层，对应斯密'低成本学校+考试激励'的原初设计。
监管影响评估：OECD RIA 框架要求先证市场失灵、再证干预净收益、后测捕获风险，是斯密两段证明的制度化。
数字平台治理：数据外部性、注意力垄断与算法合谋，划定新的市场失灵边界，但治理工具需先过'不被捕获'检验。

modern_applications_en.app: Public-goods financing design: for positive-externality domains — lighthouses, basic research, epidemic warning — first establish that individuals cannot recover the benefit, then choose taxation, user fees, or blended finance by Smith's standard.

Education policy: layer universal public provision of basic schooling above competitive market-based vocational training, matching Smith's original design of cheap schools with examinations and prizes.
Regulatory impact assessment: the OECD RIA framework requires proving market failure, then net intervention benefit, then testing capture risk — the institutionalization of Smith's two-stage proof.
Digital platform governance: data externalities, attention monopoly, and algorithmic collusion redraw the boundary of market failure, but every governance tool must first pass the non-capture test.
